levels.surface: أبي محمد أخي يونس بن يعقوب

notes: Last link is Yunus, who narrates in the first person («كنت بالمدينة») an encounter in which the Imam speaks and acts. Whether the Imam is a link or only a scene actor is rule 11: flagged, not decided.
«أبي محمد أخي يونس بن يعقوب» is kept as one surface: a kunya with a brother relation in the same phrase.
«أبيه» is a bare relation link; the father is not named.
